nodes.text: 2025 is turning out to be a crummy year so far! First there was a drive by shooting in New Orleans on New Year’s, a crazy blizzard that happened in the Midwest and now a wildfire epidemic in LA! What’s next? Oh let me guess, a second pandemic due to the HMPV virus!
